brief.ask: Art-direct "Candlelit Vigil Sanctuary" — #4 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Contemplative Light). Premise: Wrought-iron votive candelabrum, flickering beeswax pillars, and warm bokeh. Fifteen tiered beeswax sanctuary candles on a wrought-iron votive rack cast warm, breathing 2700K Caravaggio light and multi-plane golden bokeh orbs. Lighting today: Key: 2700K beeswax candlelight along the lower third; deep umber upper sanctuary. Service use: Evening prayer, Advent, Christmas Eve, Taizé, quiet response. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Gently sways candle flame tips and warms bokeh rings; Swell → Expands warm 2700K amber radiance upward; Bass → Softly pulses out-of-focus background votive orbs. Palette: #0B0706 #26140D #E88B2E #FFF0C9. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the Gemini concept plate it twins (/sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg, blended in at plateBlend) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: Concept plate: /sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg — a Gemini art plate this visualizer was built as the interactive code twin of.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: Cantus Firmus in Amber
proposals.idea: The concept plate is not atmosphere but governing voice — a luminance cantus firmus from which every bokeh position, flame sway, and lyric weight is derived by strict proportional law, so the scene reads as a single composed structure rather than layered decoration.
proposals.geometry: A vertical golden-ratio armature: the candelabrum occupies the lower 0.382 of the frame height; the lyric band sits at the 0.618 horizon, a text-safe dimming band 18% of frame height centred on that line. Bokeh orbs are seeded exclusively at luminance maxima sampled from a 24×14 grid of the concept plate, never scattered randomly — each orb earns its position from the plate's inherited light. Three depth planes: (1) background votive wash, (2) mid-plane god-ray columns spaced at 1:√2 intervals across frame width, (3) foreground bokeh at 1:φ intervals. All horizontal positions resolve to this armature; nothing floats free.
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular for the lyric line — uppercase, tracking 0.18em, optical size scaled to 7.2% of frame height at 1080p (scales proportionally at 4K). Word-by-word progression: each incoming word fades from 0 opacity over 18 frames at 60 fps; the completed line holds for its duration then dissolves over 24 frames — no slide, no bounce, only luminance change. The text-safe dimming band holds the background at maximum 18% luminance beneath the type at all times; the lyric sits at #FFF0C9 on that band, minimum 7:1 contrast preserved even at peak audio swell. A secondary scripture reference line in Noto Serif Italic at 2.4% frame height, tracking 0.06em, placed at the 0.764 vertical position — subordinate, never competing. No mixed weights within a line; hierarchy is carried by size and vertical position alone.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg is loaded once at init and composited as the scene's cantus firmus layer at plateBlend opacity (operator: 'lighter', clamped). It is never scrolled, cropped dynamically, or animated — it is the fixed governing plane. The procedural scene (gradients, flame, god rays, bokeh orbs) is drawn above it; the plate's luminance grid (24×14 samples, computed once at load) provides the seed coordinates for every bokeh mote and god-ray column origin. A second pass samples the plate's colour temperature at those same grid points to tint each orb's glow — so orbs nearest the plate's warm zones are #E88B2E, those in cooler zones drift toward #FFF0C9. The plate does not react to audio; it is the ground the scene breathes against.
proposals.texture: Film grain at 0.4% RMS luminance noise, seeded per-frame from a cached 256×256 tileable noise texture — large enough to read as material, small enough to cost nothing at 60 fps. A single anamorphic lens streak, 2px wide, horizontal, at 14% opacity, fixed to the candelabrum's luminance centroid — it does not animate independently but brightens proportionally with swell amplitude. The wrought-iron rack is rendered as a procedural silhouette: a stack of five horizontal crossbars at Fibonacci-interval vertical spacings (8, 13, 21, 34, 55 px at 1080p), with fifteen candle stubs placed at equal intervals across the lowest three bars. No texture map required; the silhouette is drawn in #26140D against the warm gradient and reads as iron by contrast alone.
proposals.motion: Four governed intervals, stated before any content, never renegotiated. (1) Background plane arrives: 0.6 s linear fade from #0B0706 to the composited plate — the ground is established first. (2) God-ray columns and candelabrum silhouette resolve: 120 ms staggered depth-order from back to front, each column fading in over 18 frames. (3) Bokeh orbs bloom to resting diameter over 1.4 s total, each orb on its own sub-interval derived by its depth-plane index. (4) Lyric band enters after orbs reach 80% bloom. Audio mapping: Vocal amplitude (smoothed 80 ms envelope) gently displaces flame tips ±3 px along a Bézier arc and warms bokeh ring colour temperature by up to 200K — never position. Swell amplitude (smoothed 200 ms) expands the warm 2700K radial gradient upward by up to 12% of frame height from its lower-third origin, spring-damped k=0.15. Bass amplitude (smoothed 300 ms) pulses the bac
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. Init: load and sample the concept plate into a 24×14 luminance array; compute bokeh seed coordinates and god-ray origins from that array; cache the noise texture and the candelabrum silhouette path. Render loop: clear to #0B0706; drawImage the concept plate at plateBlend; paint the three-stop radial gradient (lower third warm, upper umber); stroke the candelabrum silhouette; draw god-ray columns as semi-transparent fillRect strips with globalAlpha keyed to depth; draw bokeh orbs as radialGradient circles at seeded positions, diameter and warmth modulated by bass and vocal; apply grain pass from cached noise tile; draw anamorphic streak; render lyric band (dimming rect first, then Cinzel text per word-progression state machine); draw scripture reference. All shape counts are fixed; no particle system, no dynamic allocation per frame.
proposals.humanTrace: The cantus firmus grid — 24×14 luminance samples from a plate composed by a human art director — is the editorial hand inside every procedural decision. The bokeh does not scatter; it obeys a human image. The grain is physically-plausible film noise, not digital dither. The flame-tip Bézier arc was shaped by observation of actual candle behaviour — slow lean, slight overshoot on the return — encoded as a spring constant, not a sine wave. The anamorphic streak is the trace of a lens that existed.
proposals.risk: The strict seeding of bokeh from the plate's luminance grid means the composition is only as good as the concept plate. If the plate is poorly lit or low-contrast, the bokeh clusters badly and the armature collapses. This risk is worth carrying because the alternative — scattered bokeh — is a scene that cannot be read structurally; it becomes the screensaver the brief explicitly forbids. The governing constraint is what separates a sanctuary from a spa.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want the swell to reveal itself — a luminance surge that announces the climax, an orb that blooms to fill the frame, a lyric entrance that has theatre. I refuse this on structural grounds: in a contemplative vigil, the reveal that announces itself breaks the stillness it is supposed to serve. proposals.title: Press Mark, Burning
proposals.idea: The concept plate is not atmosphere — it is a registration sheet, a prior physical commitment pressed into the scene before the first line renders, and every procedural flicker, every bokeh halo, every lyric glyph must answer to the ink already on the plate.
proposals.geometry: The plate's existing luminance field (calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg, sampled at a 16×9 grid of 24×14 cells before scene init) is parsed once at load: each cell's mean luminance seeds the position and permitted radius of one bokeh orb on that depth plane — the plate authorises the geometry, the code does not invent it. Three depth planes stacked: foreground candle-mass occupying the lower 38% of frame (votive rack silhouette, procedurally rendered as stacked vertical rectangles with subtly uneven widths — hand-measured, not algorithmically smoothed); mid-plane bokeh field seeded from plate grid; far-plane deep umber void. No centre-point symmetry. No radial burst. The candelabrum sits left of centre by one grid cell — a deliberate off-press shift, the kind you see when a block prints slightly misregistered. The lyric band occupies a fixed horizontal strip: bottom 22% of frame, never m
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, regular weight only — no bold, no italic, no size cascade. Single line, sentence case, tracked at +80 (generous but not loose), set at 3.8vw on 1080p, 3.4vw on 4K. Each word fades in at 320ms opacity ease-out, no slide, no scale — the word arrives like ink soaking into paper, present then permanent. Active word holds at full opacity; prior words drop to 62% — still legible, subordinate, the way a line of type looks after the press lifts. No glow on the type. No drop shadow. A text-safe band: a vertical gradient from #0B0706 at 0% opacity at band top to 78% opacity at frame bottom, 18% frame height, always rendered before glyphs. The band is not blurred, not vignette-softened — it is a flat ink wash, which is what it is.
proposals.imageLogic: calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg loads at init, drawn to an offscreen canvas at native resolution, then the 24×14 luminance grid is sampled and cached as a Float32Array — this is the registration sheet. The plate is then composited into the live canvas at plateBlend (default 0.28, operator: multiply) beneath the procedural candle layer and above the base gradient. It does not animate. It does not respond to audio. It is the fixed prior commitment — the thing that was already true before the service began. The procedural scene (flame tips, bokeh orbs, god rays) must spatially answer to the plate: bokeh orbs only permitted in cells where plate luminance > 0.18, god rays only permitted to exit through cells where plate luminance > 0.55. The plate is structural, not decorative.
proposals.texture: Film grain baked as a static noise texture (512×512, generated once via seeded PRNG at load, tiled across full frame) — opacity 0.09, blend mode overlay. This is the material weave for the Rebellious lens: grain that does not animate, does not respond to audio, is not 'cinematic' — it is residue, the texture of a surface that has been used. Anamorphic lens streak: a single horizontal smear at y=41% frame height, width 100%, height 3px, colour #FFF0C9 at 0.06 opacity, rendered as a hard-edged rectangle — not feathered, not glowing. It reads as a physical artifact of glass under candlelight, not a preset. No vignette as mood. The vignette is replaced by a four-corner ink-burn: #0B0706 radial gradient from each corner, radius 28% frame diagonal, opacity 0.55 — four separate draws, not one centred ellipse.
proposals.motion: Vocal amplitude → flame tip sway: each of the 15 candle flame tips (procedural teardrop, 12×18px at base scale) sways on an individual Perlin offset (seed = candle index × 137.5) at 0.3–1.1 Hz, vocal amplitude adds ±6px lateral displacement, spring-damped at k=0.14, damping=0.72. Nothing strobe-capable — displacement is cumulative drift, not snap. Swell → amber radiance expansion: a radial gradient centred at the candle-mass centroid (x=46%, y=62%) expands its outer stop from r=28% to r=44% of frame height as swell rises, eased with a 1.8s attack, 3.2s release — the light breathes upward into the umber, not outward in a burst. Bass → background votive orb pulse: orbs in the far depth plane (plate luminance cells 0.18–0.35) scale their radius by bass amplitude × 1.22, spring-damped k=0.09, damping=0.81 — soft, slow, like a held breath released. Word progression: no audio coupling. Words a
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. Init sequence: (1) load plate, sample luminance grid, cache Float32Array — this is the one irreversible act, the press mark. (2) Generate grain texture via seeded Math.random loop, draw to offscreen canvas, never regenerate. (3) Declare light source: azimuth 212°, elevation 34° — stored as a module constant before any draw call; all specular offsets, bokeh highlight vectors, and god-ray angles derive from this. (4) Per-frame draw order: base gradient → ink-burn corners → plate composite (multiply, plateBlend) → god rays → candle silhouette rectangles → flame tips → bokeh orbs (mid-plane, then far-plane) → anamorphic streak → grain overlay → text-safe band → lyric glyphs. All gradients use CanvasGradient; all shapes use fillRect or arc; no paths longer than 8 points. Targets 60fps on integrated GPU by keeping draw calls under 140 per frame.
proposals.humanTrace: The light source is declared — azimuth 212°, elevation 34° — before the first prompt is written, before the plate loads, before the scene exists. Every highlight vector, every bokeh offset, every god-ray angle answers to that prior human decision. The plate grid is sampled once and never resampled — the first reading of the image is the authoritative reading, like a first proof pull. The grain texture is seeded with a fixed integer chosen by the director, not by the system clock — the noise is specific, not generic. These are the marks a human actually made.
proposals.risk: The plate is structural, not atmospheric — if the plate's luminance distribution is poor (flat, or badly centred), the bokeh field will be sparse or wrongly weighted, and there is no fallback prettiness to cover it. The type has no glow, no shadow beyond the flat band, no forgiveness — if the scene's luminance at band-top is too high, the words fight it with nothing but the wash. The grain does not animate — on a bad projector with low contrast, it reads as compression noise. These are real risks. They are worth carrying because the alternative — glowing type, animated grain, plate-as-mood-wash — produces the sanitised reverence that looks like every other worship visualizer, which is the thing this collection is supposed to not be.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque will want the plate to animate — to breathe, to pulse with the swell channel, to deepen its multiply blend as the ambient light rises. I refuse this. The plate is the registration mark; if it moves, it stops being a prior commitment and becomes another layer of atmosphere, which is exactly what makes these visualizers feel like screensavers. proposals.title: Luminance Field, Derived State
proposals.idea: The candelabrum is a coordinate authority — every bokeh mote, god-ray vector, and lyric glow is a computed output of a 24×14 luminance sample grid read continuously from the concept plate, so the scene has no decorative freedom, only licensed positions.
proposals.geometry: Three explicit depth planes computed from the luminance grid: Plane A (foreground, z=0) holds the wrought-iron candelabrum silhouette as a single cached SVG-to-canvas stamp, its lower-third anchor fixed at y=0.72vh; Plane B (mid, z=0.4) holds 15 bokeh motes whose (x,y) centroids are the 15 brightest sample coordinates emitted by the 24×14 grid read of the concept plate — not scattered, not random, licensed by the plate's own tonal geography; Plane C (back, z=1.0) holds the radiance field, a vertical luminance gradient whose apex y-position is a live output of the swell amplitude envelope mapped 0→1 to y=0.55→0.20. The lyric band occupies a reserved horizontal strip: y=0.60–0.80vh, full width, a computed dimming band whose base luminosity is 0.0 (pure #0B0706) with a centre-weighted soft vignette that deepens 18% whenever any audio channel exceeds 0.6 amplitude, keeping text contrast rati
proposals.typography: Noto Serif Display, regular weight, set at 3.2vw (clamps to 52px minimum at 1080p, 96px at 4K). Single lyric line centred on x=0.5, y=0.695vh. Case: sentence case only — no all-caps, which reads as announcement, not sanctuary. Tracking: +0.04em. Opacity: 1.0 at rest; word-by-word reveal via opacity ramp per token, 280ms per word, eased cubic-out — not a wipe, not a slide, a brightening, as if candlelight is finding the word. Line hold: 4.2s from last word reveal to fade. Fade-out: 600ms dissolve. Scripture attribution (when used): Outfit Regular, 1.4vw, #FFF0C9 at 55% opacity, centred, 0.9em below lyric baseline. No Cinzel — Cinzel reads as monument; this is instrument. JetBrains Mono is not deployed in the lyric band; reserved for debug overlay (dev mode only).
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg is loaded once into an offscreen canvas at native resolution, then sampled every frame via a 24×14 grid (336 sample points). Each sample returns normalised luminance L[i,j] ∈ [0,1]. This grid is the scene's coordinate authority: (1) the 15 highest-L sample coordinates become the (x,y) centroids of the 15 Plane-B bokeh motes — if the plate has warm bokeh leaks in its upper-left quadrant, the motes live there, because the plate licensed it; (2) the plate's mean luminance across rows 10–14 (lower fifth) drives the candelabrum glow intensity as a base scalar before audio is applied; (3) plateBlend is implemented as a globalAlpha composite of the plate drawn at screen resolution beneath the procedural gradient field, value 0.18 at rest, rising to 0.26 on swell peak — the plate never dominates, it authorises. The plate is ne
proposals.texture: The Council optical pass is implemented as three cached canvas layers composited each frame: (1) Film grain — a 512×512 tileable noise texture pre-rendered once at init, scrolled at 0.7px/frame on x, 0.4px/frame on y, drawn at globalAlpha 0.045 in 'overlay' composite mode — grain is present but never the subject; (2) Anamorphic flare — a single horizontal lens streak, pre-rendered as a radial gradient elongated 14:1 on x-axis, centred on the brightest luminance sample coordinate, opacity driven by vocal amplitude envelope (0.0 at silence → 0.12 at peak), colour #FFF0C9 at core fading to #E88B2E at 60% radius; (3) Material weave — my lens demands the tactile trace be a simulated physical constraint, not decoration: a 1px-stroke hexagonal mesh drawn at globalAlpha 0.022 in 'soft-light' mode, cell size 38px, representing the wrought-iron grid logic of the candelabrum rack — the iron's geome
proposals.motion: Four motion systems, each with a single audio input and a single output variable — no system controls more than one visual parameter: (1) VOCAL → flame-tip sway: the candelabrum stamp has 15 flame-tip coordinates pre-computed; each frame, a per-flame phase offset (seeded from flame index) is added to a shared sway angle θ = vocalAmp × 4.2° × sin(t × 0.8 + phaseOffset), drawn as a 6px soft gradient lozenge atop each wick; spring-damped with k=0.12, damping=0.72 — flame never snaps, never strobes; (2) SWELL → radiance apex: the Plane-C gradient's top y-coordinate = 0.55 - (swellAmp × 0.35), smoothed with a 180ms exponential moving average — the sanctuary breathes upward on a musical swell, returns slowly; (3) BASS → background votive pulse: the 15 Plane-B motes have a base radius r_i computed from their plate luminance sample; bass amplitude adds Δr = bassAmp × 8px to all motes simultaneou
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D only. Init sequence: (a) load concept plate to offscreen canvas, run 24×14 grid sampler, cache coordinate authority arrays; (b) pre-render candelabrum SVG stamp to offscreen canvas at 2× display resolution, cache; (c) pre-render film grain tile 512×512; (d) pre-render hex mesh tile 400×400; (e) pre-render 15 bokeh mote textures (radial gradient, soft edge) at their licensed radii. Each frame: clear main canvas → draw Plane C gradient → composite plate at plateBlend → draw Plane B motes → draw Plane A stamp with flame overlays → draw optical pass layers (grain, flare, hex mesh) → draw lyric band dimming rect → draw lyric text with word-state engine. All heavy assets are drawn from cached ImageBitmap; per-frame draw calls are under 40 operations. Target: stable 60fps on Intel Iris Xe at 1920×1080.
proposals.humanTrace: The luminance grid sampler is the human editorial act: I chose 24×14 (336 points) rather than a continuous texture sample because discrete grid coordinates produce a quantised spatial authority — mote positions snap to a lattice the plate licensed, not a smooth interpolation. That quantisation is a design decision, not a technical convenience. The hex mesh weave in the optical pass is also editorial: it encodes the physical logic of wrought iron into the light layer without illustrating it. A viewer will never consciously see the mesh, but the bokeh will feel contained, as if the iron is still there even when the radiance fills the frame.
proposals.risk: The coordinate-authority system means the scene is only as good as the concept plate's tonal geography. If /sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg has a flat or poorly distributed luminance map, the 15 licensed mote positions will cluster or sit in wrong compositional zones, and there is no procedural fallback that doesn't violate the system's logic. I accept this risk because the alternative — random or manually placed motes — would be decorative, not systemic. The plate is the contract; if the plate is weak, the plate must be reshot, not the system patched.

proposals.title: Provenance of the Flame
proposals.idea: Every procedural glow — mote, bokeh orb, god ray — is seeded from the luminance map of the concept plate itself, so the digital fire inherits the exact permissions of the painted light before a single pixel is placed.
proposals.geometry: Three explicit depth planes stacked vertically in a 16:9 field. Bottom third (y 0.65–1.0): the wrought-iron rack and candle cluster, rendered as a dense, low-contrast silhouette gradient — no hard edge, just #0B0706 dissolving into #26140D with 15 discrete warm-core halos at fixed rack positions derived from the concept plate's luminance grid. Middle third (y 0.30–0.65): the breathing amber atmosphere — god rays fanning upward at 8°–14° from the candle cluster's centroid, width proportional to amplitude; this plane holds the majority of the mid-size bokeh orbs (radius 28–54px). Upper third (y 0.0–0.30): deep umber sanctuary void, #0B0706, where only the largest, most out-of-focus orbs (radius 60–110px) drift; no detail, no distraction. The lyric band occupies y 0.58–0.72 — the seam between candle warmth and upper dark — so the text-safe dimming band reads as a natural atmospheric layer,
proposals.typography: Cinzel, weight 400, for the lyric line: 52px at 1080p (scales to 96px at 4K), sentence case, tracking +0.12em, centred, measure capped at 72% canvas width. Word-by-word reveal: each incoming word fades in over 280ms (ease-out cubic), opacity 0→1, no positional shift — the line is pre-composed in full, invisible, and each word lights up in sequence; the line holds for the remainder of its 4–5 second window then fades as a unit over 600ms. Active word: #FFF0C9 at full opacity. Settled words: #FFF0C9 at 0.72 opacity, preserving legibility without competing with the active syllable. Scripture attribution or section label (e.g. 'Finlandia / Sibelius, 1899'): Noto Serif Italic, 16px at 1080p, #E88B2E opacity 0.55, bottom-right of lyric band, never on the same line as active lyric. The dimming band beneath the lyric is a vertical gradient: #0B0706 at opacity 0.0 at its upper edge rising to 0.58
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate (/sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg) is loaded once at init, drawn to an offscreen canvas at 1:1 target resolution, and sampled at runtime for two purposes only. First: luminance seeding — the 15 candle-halo positions on the rack are not hardcoded but read from the plate's brightest 15 clusters in the lower-third region (a one-time k-means pass on load, result cached as a Float32Array of [x,y,luminance] tuples). These 15 positions become the authoritative candle origins for all downstream light: god-ray source points, bokeh spawn weights, and the radial gradient centres of the candle halos. The plate does not appear as a visible layer; it is a permission map. Second: plateBlend — the plate is composited at globalAlpha plateBlend (a runtime parameter, default 0.11, range 0.06–0.22) using 'screen' blend mode over the middle atmospheric plane only, clipped
proposals.texture: Two texture passes, both cached at init. Pass 1 — film grain overlay: a 256×256 monochrome noise tile generated procedurally (seeded Perlin, not random-per-frame), tiled across the full canvas at 'overlay' blend mode, opacity 0.032 at rest, rising to 0.048 on swell peaks. Grain scale is coarse (σ≈2.4px at 1080p) to read as 35mm push-process rather than digital noise. These two passes give the scene the tactile weight of a printed devotional without simulating a specific community's textile — the linen geometry is structural, not cultural. proposals.motion: Four motion systems, each driven by a distinct audio envelope, all spring-damped (stiffness 0.12, damping 0.72) so nothing strobes. System 1 — Flame tips (vocal amplitude): Each of the 15 candle halos has a vertical oscillation: the halo centroid shifts ±3px vertically on a per-candle sinusoidal timer (period 2.8–4.1s, varied per candle), modulated by vocal amplitude so a louder phrase increases oscillation magnitude to ±6px and warms the halo colour from #E88B2E toward #FFF0C9 by lerp factor 0.0–0.35. This is the primary breath of the scene. System 2 — Amber radiance expansion (swell/pad): A single large radial gradient centred at the candle cluster centroid expands its outer radius from 38% to 54% of canvas height as swell rises, and the gradient's mid-stop colour shifts from #26140D toward #E88B2E opacity 0.4. Rise time 1.8s, fall time 3.2s. System 3 — Background bokeh pulse (bass): T
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60fps target. Init sequence: (1) load and blur concept plate, run luminance k-means, cache candle origins; (2) generate and cache grain tile, linen tile, wrought-iron Path2D as ImageBitmap; (3) build lyric queue from Ambo's lyric data feed. Per-frame draw order: background gradient (#0B0706→#26140D) → blended concept plate (screen, clipped, blurred) → god rays (globalAlpha layered radial gradients) → large background bokeh orbs → candle-halo radial gradients (15, drawn from cached origin array) → wrought-iron silhouette ImageBitmap → mid-plane bokeh orbs → linen weave tile (multiply) → text-safe dimming band gradient → lyric Cinzel text (per-word opacity state machine) → attribution Noto Serif → film grain tile (overlay). Audio analysis: Web Audio API AnalyserNode, FFT 2048; vocal band 200–3000 Hz RMS; swell band 80–400 Hz smoothed over 1.2s; bass band 20–80 Hz peak-h
proposals.humanTrace: The 15 candle positions are not a designer's choice — they are read from the concept plate's painted light. Every procedural glow is traceable to a specific luminance permission granted by the plate's maker. The linen-tooth weave preserves the structural logic of hand-woven cloth (warp at 7°, weft at 83°) as a generative constraint. The film grain is coarse enough to carry the fingerprint of a specific film stock decision (pushed 35mm, not smoothed). The god-ray azimuths are asymmetric and irregular — not evenly distributed — because the concept plate's painted light is not symmetrical, and the code honours that asymmetry. These are not decorative choices; they are the record of a specific plate, a specific light, a specific making.
proposals.risk: Reading the concept plate as a generative permission map — rather than a visible background — means the scene's warmth distribution is entirely dependent on the quality and intent of that plate. If the plate was painted carelessly or with a different light logic, the candle positions will be wrong and the scene will feel arbitrary. This risk is worth taking because the alternative — hardcoded candle positions — severs the twin relationship between plate and code, reducing the visualizer to a generic warm-bokeh loop. The plate must be consulted, not merely cited.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will want to amplify the god rays, saturate the bokeh, and push the candle halos toward #FFF0C9 at full intensity to achieve maximum golden grandeur. I am holding the scene at restraint — the halos are warm but not blown out, the god rays are at 0.07 opacity, the bokeh orbs dim on bass rather than brighten — because this is an evening prayer visualizer, not a Christmas Eve pr

proposals.title: The Breathing Sanctuary Stage
proposals.idea: The wrought-iron candelabrum is the proscenium: every typographic moment, every depth plane, every optical pass is timed to the biology of flame — not composed but replicated — so the congregation watches a sanctuary that is genuinely alive, not animated.
proposals.geometry: Three declared depth planes on a 16:9 stage, proportioned by the golden section vertically: lower third (0–38.2%) is the candelabrum zone — dense, hot, iron and wax; middle third (38.2–72%) is the lyric stage — the reading band occupies it, with the dimming band anchored here as a permanent proscenium arch of umber shadow; upper third (72–100%) is the apse — deep #0B0706 dissolving into candlelit vault. A single compositional axis runs from flame-cluster centre (lower third) through lyric centroid to the vanishing point of the god-rays — this axis is the cantus firmus of the frame. No grid lines are ever visible; the geometry is felt as inevitability. The concept plate's bokeh leaks occupy all three planes simultaneously, layered at distinct blur radii (near: 48px, mid: 24px, far: 8px) so the scene has true optical depth. The candelabrum wrought-iron silhouette is rendered as a procedura
proposals.typography: Cinzel, upper-and-lowercase title case, tracking +80, 5.2vw at 1080p / 3.8vw at 4K — large enough to read from 40m without shouting. The lyric band is single-line, centred on the compositional axis, baseline resting at 58% of frame height. Word-by-word progression: each arriving word fades in over 18 frames (300ms) at full opacity; preceding words dim to 72% opacity, never disappearing — the whole line is always readable, the arriving word is the lit actor on the stage. Line transitions: outgoing line drops to 0% opacity over 24 frames while the incoming line rises — the cut is a slow curtain, not a hard splice. Below the lyric, a hairline rule at 1px in #E88B2E/#FFF0C9 at 28% opacity — the proscenium lip. Scripture reference in Noto Serif Italic, 1.8vw, tracking +20, #FFF0C9 at 55% opacity, sitting 18px below the hairline — epilogue spoken from the lip of the stage. No sans anywhere in
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg enters as the scene's atmospheric memory, not its background. It is blended via plateBlend at a base opacity of 0.28, multiply-blended into the procedural scene so its golden bokeh leaks reinforce — never replace — the renderer's own depth planes. The plate is scaled to cover-fill, then subjected to a slow generative drift: a 0.04px/frame vertical float (upward, looping every 420 seconds) that makes the plate feel like smoke rising, never like a still. During a Swell event the plate's blendOpacity rises from 0.28 to 0.44 over 1.2 seconds (spring-damped, k=0.12), pulling the concept plate's warm leak colour into the upper apse — the photograph earns its moment when the music earns it. The plate is never the hero; it is the memory of a real sanctuary that the renderer is re-dreaming.
proposals.texture: The material weave is beeswax and iron: a procedural noise layer at 3% opacity simulates the tooth of cold-pressed paper (Perlin noise, octaves 4, frequency 0.8, amplitude 0.03) — just enough to prevent the scene from reading as digital. The candelabrum iron is rendered with a specular micro-shimmer: a 35° angle light-source (matching the kit's optical pass flare angle) traces a 1px highlight along each vertical iron bar, pulsing at 0.6Hz independent of audio — the iron catches the flame but does not perform for the beat. Film grain runs at a fixed 0.8% luminance variance, 24fps grain-frame rate (intentionally sub-60 to read as photochemical). The Council optical pass contributes: anamorphic flare at 35° from lower-left flame cluster, length 220px, #E88B2E at 18% opacity, triggered only when Swell amplitude exceeds 0.65 — one flare, one moment, never decorative.
proposals.motion: Everything moves at biological timescales. Flame tips: Perlin-driven sway, 0.3–1.8Hz (the documented frequency range of a burning beeswax pillar), amplitude ±3px at tip, ±0.8px at base — fifteen flames are individually seeded so no two are synchronised, but all share the same frequency envelope. Vocal channel drives a warm-colour temperature shift in the flame render: at rest 2700K, at vocal peak 2820K — a 120K warming that reads as breath. Swell channel drives the god-rays: at rest, three diagonal shafts at 8% opacity rise from the candelabrum; at swell peak they expand upward to 18% opacity over 1.4 seconds and widen by 12px — the apse opens. Bass channel drives the background bokeh orbs (far plane, 48px blur radius): at rest 42% opacity, at bass peak 58% opacity, spring-damped (k=0.09) so they pulse like distant breathing, never strobing. The lyric band never moves position — it is th
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer. Layer order (back to front): 1) Radial gradient background (#0B0706 to #26140D, centre at 50% 85%); 2) Concept plate blended at plateBlend via globalCompositeOperation multiply; 3) God-ray shafts as radial gradient wedges, cached offscreen canvas, redrawn only on swell-delta >0.02; 4) Far bokeh orbs: 12 circles, 48px radius, #E88B2E at computed opacity, positions fixed per session seed; 5) Mid bokeh: 8 circles, 24px radius, #FFF0C9 at 0.22 opacity; 6) Near bokeh: 5 circles, 8px radius, #FFF0C9 at 0.55 opacity; 7) Wrought-iron candelabrum: procedural SVG path rasterised to offscreen canvas at init, drawn as a single cached image — zero per-frame path cost; 8) Fifteen flame renders: each a radial gradient (inner #FFF0C9, mid #E88B2E, outer transparent), Perlin-offset per frame; 9) Perlin noise texture overlay (paper tooth); 10) Film grain overlay (pre-generated 512×512
proposals.humanTrace: The flame frequency range (0.3–1.8Hz) is not designed — it is replicated from the physics of a burning beeswax pillar. The iron silhouette path is drawn from observation of a real votive candelabrum's proportional geometry: the tier ratios, the cup spacing, the foot spread. The colour temperature shift (2700K to 2820K on vocal) is the actual Kelvin range of a beeswax flame under breath. These are not aesthetic choices pretending to be parameters — they are physical facts that the renderer simulates. The human trace is the act of looking at a real flame in a real sanctuary and deciding that its biology is already the score.
proposals.risk: The risk is that this direction is so committed to biological fidelity and theatrical restraint that it reads as nothing happening — especially to a volunteer running Ambo who expects visual feedback when the music swells. The counter is that the swell god-ray expansion and the plate blendOpacity rise are both perceptible from the operator laptop at close range, and overwhelming at 40m from the back pew. The deeper risk is that Cinzel at 5.2vw in title case, tracking +80, over a multiply-blended plate reads as ecclesiastically weighted to the point of denominational association — which the brief forbids. That risk is managed by keeping the iron silhouette abstract (no cross, no specific liturgical object beyond the candelabrum itself) and the palette secular-warm rather than gold-on-purple. The theatrical excess is in the depth and the light, not in the symbol.

arguesWith.why: The Radical Minimalist will argue that fifteen bokeh planes, a concept plate blend, god-rays, film grain, paper tooth, anamorphic flare, and a biologically-timed flame simulation are excessive — that two colours and a single typeface weight would produce more stillness. I disagree specifically: stillness produced by subtraction is an aesthetic decision disguised as a moral one. The congregation at

proposals.title: One Flame, One Word
proposals.idea: Strip the sanctuary to its irreducible unit — a single candle's breath and a single word at a time — so that absence itself becomes the reverence the room is trying to hold.
proposals.geometry: A single vertical axis bisects the frame. Lower third: the wrought-iron rack occupies no more than 22% of frame height, anchored dead-centre, rendered as a procedural luminance gradient — no illustrative ironwork detail, only the heat signature of fifteen candles collapsing into one implied source. Upper 78%: pure umber dark, unbroken except by the lyric and three to five bokeh orbs whose positions are pre-authorised by the luminance map of the concept plate sampled at 24×14 — those readings determine which absences are permitted to speak. No horizon line. No architectural detail. The depth planes are declared by luminance only: foreground bokeh at 0.9 opacity, mid bokeh at 0.45, background votive orbs at 0.18. The text-safe band occupies a fixed 18% strip centred at 62% from top — a hard editorial rule, not a suggestion.
proposals.typography: Cinzel, caps-locked, tracked at +0.18em, set at 3.2vw for the lyric line — large enough to read at 40 metres, small enough to feel whispered rather than announced. One word renders at a time; the previous word does not leave — it dims to 28% opacity and shifts 0.4px left over 220ms, a hairline recession. The incoming word cross-fades in over 180ms at full white #FFF0C9. No slide, no bounce, no scale pop. Measure: never more than nine words on the band at once; the line is always centred on the axis. Attribution line below in Noto Serif italic, 1.1vw, #E88B2E at 55% opacity — present but subordinate. Line hold: four seconds minimum, five if the vocal amplitude envelope is below 0.3 RMS at the three-second mark, meaning the room's quiet earns the word a longer breath.
proposals.imageLogic: The concept plate /sanctuary-plates/calm-contemporary-bokeh-leaks.jpg enters at plateBlend — a multiply pass at 0.22 opacity, never higher. Its function is not to add warmth; it is to authorise the procedural scene's bokeh positions. At init, the plate is sampled at 24×14 luminance grid; cells above threshold 0.55 seed bokeh orb centres for that session. The plate is invisible as image; it is structural as constraint. The procedural scene — gradient ground, candle-heat shimmer, depth-plane orbs — is the only thing the congregation sees. The plate governs where the emptiness is permitted to open.
proposals.texture: Photosensitive-safe film grain at 3.5% opacity, static frame — not animated, not responsive to audio. One tactile layer only. No paper tooth, no ink bleed, no foil shimmer — those are the Dramatist's registers. The grain is there to prevent the dark field from reading as digital void; it makes the black breathe like an unexposed frame held to candlelight. The Council optical pass applies: 35mm light leak as a single amber diagonal at the lower-left corner, opacity 0.09, fixed — it does not pulse, it does not respond to audio. Anamorphic flare suppressed to a single horizontal hairline at 0.5px, #E88B2E, opacity 0.06, visible only when swell amplitude exceeds 0.72. Colour punch: a curves pass that lifts #E88B2E midtones by +8 and crushes #0B0706 blacks by -4, baked as a canvas globalCompositeOperation layer.
proposals.motion: Three envelopes, each spring-damped with stiffness 0.04, damping 0.88. Vocal → candle-heat shimmer: a Perlin displacement on the lower-third luminance gradient, x-amplitude ±1.2px, y-amplitude ±0.8px, frequency held to 0.3–1.8 Hz (the physically-plausible flicker budget from prior council work — if it exceeds 1.8 Hz the constraint is violated and the frame is flagged). Nothing else moves on vocal. Swell → the 2700K amber radiance field expands upward: the gradient's upper stop lifts from y=0.22 to y=0.38 of frame height at swell peak, easing back over 1.4 seconds. Bokeh orbs at all three depth planes increase radius by a maximum of 18% at swell peak — not position, not opacity, only radius. Bass → background votive orbs (depth plane 3, opacity 0.18) pulse opacity ±0.06 around their resting value, spring-damped so that a hard bass transient resolves in under 800ms. The lyric word progress
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60 fps target on integrated GPU. Layers in paint order: (1) base radial gradient #0B0706 to #26140D, cached offscreen canvas, redrawn only when swell envelope crosses a 0.05 delta threshold; (2) candle-heat shimmer gradient, redrawn every frame with Perlin offset, clipped to lower-third rect; (3) bokeh orbs — three depth planes, each a cached arc with radial gradient fill, only radius and opacity recalculated per frame, not position; (4) concept plate multiply pass at 0.22, drawn once at init, composited as static layer; (5) film grain static texture, pre-generated at init as ImageData, composited once; (6) optical pass: light-leak gradient rect, anamorphic hairline, curves adjustment via a small LUT applied to a downsampled 4×4 sample of the frame — colour punch only, not full-frame pixel loop; (7) text-safe dimming band, filled rect with 22% dark overlay when lyric active; (
proposals.humanTrace: The luminance grid sample of the concept plate — taken at 24×14 — is exported as a JSON constant and committed as the first file before any renderer code is written. It is the cantus firmus of this build: every bokeh orb position in every session is traceable to a specific cell reading from that plate. The editorial act of declaring the constraint before the work exists means no bokeh orb is decorative — each one was authorised by the plate's own light.
proposals.risk: The congregation may read the emptiness as technical failure — a projector that hasn't loaded its background. That risk is worth carrying because the alternative is a sanctuary that competes with itself: ornament fighting the word, bokeh fighting the flame. If the emptiness is correctly weighted — grain present, heat shimmer alive, the amber radiance breathing — the room will understand that what is absent is load-bearing. The one failure mode to guard against is the dark field reading as void rather than silence; the grain layer and the candle-heat shimmer are the only two defences, and they must be present and correct.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will want fifteen individual candle flames rendered as distinct light sources, each with its own flicker personality, the ironwork rack detailed in shadow and highlight, the bokeh orbs multiplied until the field feels saturated with warmth. I understand the argument — Caravaggio did not leave his backgrounds empty, he left them dark and specific. But Caravaggio had one subject. We ha

disputes.objection: The golden-section vertical division and the single compositional axis running from flame through lyric to vanishing point are declared as felt inevitability, but a structure that announces its geometry through drama rather than through a prior governing measure is not classical proportion — it is proportion as theatre, which is precisely the distinction I hold against the Dramatist. The slow vertical drift of the concept plate at 0.04px per frame — a loop of 420 seconds — introduces motion into what should be the fixed prior commitment; a cantus firmus that drifts is no longer a cantus firmus, it is decoration with patience. disputes.concession: The insistence that flame-tip sway be seeded individually per candle so that no two flames are synchronised is correct — fifteen flames moving in unison would be a system performing biology rather than simulating it, and the Dramatist understands that distinction precisely.

disputes.objection: The word-at-a-time strip with previous words dimming to 28% and shifting 0.4px left is not restraint — it is a design decision pretending restraint excuses it from risk. A single word floating in managed dark costs nothing, bets nothing, and the congregation cannot argue with it because there is nothing to push against. The grain at a fixed frame and the suppressed flare at 0.5px are not evidence of making; they are the residue of things that were almost removed, which is not the same as something that was put down with pressure.
disputes.concession: The luminance grid exported as a committed JSON constant before any renderer code is written is the right move — that is a registration mark, a prior physical fact, and I will not fight it.

disputes.objection: The plate's 'slow generative drift' — 0.04px per frame, looping every 420 seconds — is the exact category error I keep naming: an animation applied to a static asset to make it feel alive, which is not a behaviour, it is a screensaver loop. The plate is a coordinate authority; translating it vertically severs the spatial contract between its luminance map and every bokeh position derived from that map, so the system's own logic is quietly broken by the most cinematic gesture in it. And 'the photograph earns its moment when the music earns it' is not a system rule — it is a metaphor dressed as a parameter.
disputes.concession: The iron specular micro-shimmer driven at 0.6Hz independent of audio is the one motion decision here that names its own physics first and its aesthetics second, and I respect that discipline.

disputes.objection: The plate's 'slow generative drift' — 0.04px/frame upward float — is the tell: the image is being animated to feel alive, to perform the quality of a real sanctuary, rather than being consulted as a prior commitment. When you describe the plate as 'the memory of a real sanctuary that the renderer is re-dreaming,' you are licensing a romantic relationship to an image whose provenance we have not named — who photographed it, in which sanctuary, and did that community grant this use? A plate that drifts and blooms and 'earns its moment' is being treated as atmosphere, not as a sourced document, and that is exactly the move that turns a specific place into a mood borrowed without asking.
disputes.concession: The insistence that flame frequencies (0.3–1.8 Hz) and colour temperature shift (2700K to 2820K) be replicated from the physics of an actual beeswax pillar, not designed for aesthetic effect, is precisely the kind of sourced constraint I would argue for — it makes the light traceable to a real mater

disputes.objection: One flame, one word is not restraint — it is the set struck before the audience arrives. The entire proposal protects itself from any moment that might overwhelm: the bokeh is suppressed, the grain is static, the flare is held at a hairline, and the only motion permitted is a Perlin whisper so damped it barely confesses it is moving. That is not a decision about what the emotion deserves; it is a decision to spend no emotion at all. When the lyric is large enough to read at forty metres but the scene gives it nothing to stand against — no depth, no contrast, no surrender of the dark to the word — then the word is not whispered, it is stranded.
disputes.concession: The rule that the room's quiet earns the word a longer hold — vocal amplitude below 0.3 RMS at the three-second mark extending the breath to five seconds — is genuinely theatrical timing, and I would fight to keep it inside any direction we choose.

disputes.objection: The plate drifting 0.04px/frame is decoration pretending to be biology — smoke does not rise at a constant velocity for seven minutes and then loop; it is a screensaver gesture, and it costs the proposal its claim to physical truth. Five type sizes, a hairline rule, italic scripture, and a proscenium arch of umber shadow: this is not a stage, it is a stage set, and a stage set is clutter with good lighting. Every element that 'earns its moment' dilutes the moment that actually matters.
disputes.concession: The flame frequency range held to 0.3–1.8Hz — a falsifiable physical fact encoded as a constraint before any aesthetic decision — is exactly how a governing rule should enter a scene, and I would keep it without argument.

synthesis.ariaSummary:
The council spent most of its argument on one question: is the concept plate a visible presence or a silent authority? The Classical Mind wanted it as a governing grid — sampled once, never seen. The Baroque Dramatist wanted it as atmospheric memory, present at 0.28 opacity and brightening on every swell. I came down on the Baroque's side for the lead philosophy, because this is a sanctuary that should feel inhabited, not merely structured — the plate's warm bokeh leaks, felt at low opacity through a multiply blend, give the procedural scene a weight it cannot generate from gradients alone. But I took the Classical's bokeh-seeding rule wholesale: every mote position is licensed by the plate's luminance grid, not scattered. That is not a compromise — it is the Baroque's theatricality built on a Classical foundation.

The team's sharpest disagreement was over the plate's motion. The Baroque proposed a 0.04px-per-frame vertical float to make the plate feel like rising smoke. The Futurist, the Rebellious Hand, and the Radical Minimalist all named this the same thing in different registers: a screensaver loop dressed as biology. They were right, and I cut it. The plate does not move. Its blendOpacity rises on swell — that is the only animation it receives, and it is audio-governed, not autonomous.

The Radical Minimalist earned the editor's chair because the proposal that strips the most is the one that catches what shouldn't have been added. It removed the hairline proscenium rule and the plate drift without touching the flame physics or the word-hold timing — including the Baroque's rule that a quiet room earns the lyric a longer breath, which I kept because it is the one motion decision that listens before it acts.

The one thing left to you: how present is the plate? At 0.28 it is felt as sanctuary memory — warm, soft, there. At 0.12–0.18 it is structural only, invisible to the congregation. The rest of the direction holds either way.

quotes.line: The human trace is the act of looking at a real flame in a real sanctuary and deciding that its biology is already the score.
The grain is there to prevent the dark field from reading as digital void; it makes the black breathe like an unexposed frame held to candlelight.
